name: thunderbird-skill-cli
description: 面向 Claude Code Skill 的 Thunderbird 原生本地 CLI 与专用扩展：只读/可逆/草稿-外发邮件能力（真实外发默认物理关闭，需用户在扩展 options 页面显式启用可选权限；不含永久删除、watch、日历）

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:extension
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/package-extension.ts && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node scripts/package-extension.ts && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:transport: npm run build && node scripts/package-extension.ts && node --test test/transport.test.mjs
scripts.test:security: npm run build && node scripts/package-extension.ts && node --test test/discovery.test.mjs test/auth.test.mjs test/non-mcp.test.mjs test/experiment-handler.test.mjs
scripts.test:extension: npm run build && node scripts/package-extension.ts && node --test test/extension.test.mjs test/experiment-handler.test.mjs
scripts.build:plugin: npm run build && npm run package:extension && node scripts/build-plugin.ts
scripts.validate:plugin: claude plugin validate ./build/plugin && claude plugin validate .
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:plugin && npm run audit:package && npm run validate:plugin && npm run pack:dry-run
